description: This file contains service functions for managing workouts, templates, exercises, and programs in a gym management system. It includes functions for creating, listing, and ensuring ownership of resources, as well as handling pagination and user-specific workout retrieval.

methods.name: _paginate
methods.description: Applies pagination to a SQLAlchemy query based on page and page_size parameters.

methods.name: ensure_trainer_owns_template
methods.description: Verifies that a trainer owns a specific workout template.

methods.name: ensure_trainer_owns_program
methods.description: Verifies that a trainer owns or is assigned to a specific program.

methods.name: ensure_member_can_view_program
methods.description: Verifies that a member has access to view a specific program.

methods.name: create_exercise
methods.description: Creates a new exercise associated with a trainer.

methods.name: list_exercises
methods.description: Lists exercises created by a trainer with pagination.

methods.name: create_template
methods.description: Creates a new workout template for a trainer, optionally with exercises.

methods.name: list_templates
methods.description: Lists workout templates for a trainer with pagination.

methods.name: add_template_exercise
methods.description: Adds an exercise to a workout template, verifying ownership.

methods.name: delete_template_exercise
methods.description: Deletes an exercise from a template, verifying ownership.

methods.name: assign_program
methods.description: Creates and assigns a program to a member, optionally seeded from a template.

methods.name: list_programs_for_trainer
methods.description: Lists all programs created by a trainer.

methods.name: list_programs_for_member
methods.description: Lists all programs owned by a member.

methods.name: create_program_day
methods.description: Creates a new day within a program.

methods.name: list_program_days
methods.description: Lists days within a program, filtered by role (trainer or member).

methods.name: add_program_day_exercise
methods.description: Adds an exercise to a specific program day, verifying ownership.

methods.name: list_program_day_exercises
methods.description: Lists exercises for a program day, filtered by role.

methods.name: get_user_workouts
methods.description: Retrieves workouts (planned or completed) for a user.
